model: Synthetic only until published model independently verified
inference: Prior log(clearance) ~ Normal(log(4),0.5), fixed known synthetic nuisance parameters; lognormal observation noise
sequential: Refit original prior to all observed data once; strictly chronological updates
prediction: Samples by time, latent and observation draws; median and 95 percent intervals
boundaries: API creates synthetic cohort server-side; no client patient records or exposure optimization
workers: Structured JSON proposals only, orchestrator integrates explicitly
